scope: Original sound set for the cezeri-gears slot: base / idle / feature ("Fil Saati") themes, the courtyard ambience, the two-layer Dişli Kilidi tension bed, free-spins intro, retrigger, feature outro, total-win fanfare, win tiers 1–4 + max (heads, count-up beds, tier-ups, landings), 6 multiplier callout classes, the turning rings (pawl clicks per slice along the board easing, gear whirr, stop thunk), spoke-win beams (one chime per slice, pitched by symbol), hub reveal by value, the respin chain (lock clank + pins, 10-step hub tick ladder climbing the scene makam, tension bed opening per respin, short/big/full chain cadences), vessel scatters with tease and trigger, the Fil Saati reservoir and the mechanical falcon, UI effects, wordless male vocal placeholders and a 22-line recorded voice-bank slot. Presentation only; nothing reads or changes a result.
originality: All music and effects are original note data and code synthesis (lib/slot-audio/scores/cezeri.ts, sfx/cezeri.ts, synth/cezeri.ts; shared ney/zurna/horn voices from synth/anatolian.ts, bubbles from synth/ebru.ts). No samples, no recordings, no third-party melodies or motifs; no existing game, film, song or real clock chime imitated. Makam colours (Nikriz, Çargah) are generic modal material used as 12-TET approximations. Instruments are synthesized approximations (santur-like hammered dulcimer, automaton flute and water organ, clock-gong chime rods, naqqara/kös-like kettledrums, hand cymbals, escapement, pawl-and-ratchet, brass gear clanks, gear-train whirr, water-clock drips, a filling vessel, water-whistle birds, wing beats, wordless male choir and vox).

musicDirection.base: C Nikriz (C D Eb F# G A Bb), 100 BPM, 20-bar loop (48 s): A hook = the "escapement turn" (C · G · F# G F# · Eb D C) on an automaton flute over a 16th santur gear train; B in Eb Çargah (the elephant walks; ney, water organ, kös); C = the water-clock breakdown (tuned drips, flute alone over F#dim7 – D7), wound back up by a ratchet roll and gear whirr into a santur run over G7.
musicDirection.feature: Fil Saati: C Çargah (major) with the Nikriz F# kept as the chromatic neighbour of G, 112 BPM, 16-bar loop (34.3 s): the escapement turn in major on a zurna-like reed, then an automaton-band procession (flute, horn, male choir, kös on every downbeat, Ab – Bb lift).
musicDirection.clockwork: The mechanism is part of the band: escapement tick on every beat and tock on every off-beat eighth (locked to the tempo in every loop), ratchet rolls into section changes, gear clanks as the mechanism engages, water-clock drips on C6/G5, a gear-train whirr winding into the loop point.
musicDirection.chainSystem: Dişli Kilidi: lock = heavy brass clank with latch + one steel pin per newly held slice; hub +1 = escapement catch + counter flip + chime on the k-th degree of the scene makam (C Nikriz in the base game: D Eb F# G A Bb C D Eb F#, the 10th on the tense high F#; bent ≤1 semitone onto C Çargah in the feature), each step adding a layer (santur 2, naqqara 3, fifth 4, kös 5, cymbal 6, water organ 7, choir 8, bell 9, full mechanism + water whistle 10; loudness class light → medium → major → hero); two looped tension beds in lock-step (C–G–D only) behind a low-pass that opens 700 Hz → 14 kHz over the chain, the urgent upper layer rising from respin 4 to full at 8, the scene music ducked 6 → 14 dB; class callout + voice when the hub crosses ×10/×25/×50…; resolution on an open fifth (consonant with both makams): chain-end (1–2 respins), chain-end-big (3+), chain-full clock strike (10 respins or all 48 slices held).

environment.machine: cloud container, 4 vCPU shared with other agents (load average 2–9 during these runs; compare Cezeri with Tarhun measured interleaved in the same run)

method: Headless Chromium, production code path: render worker bundle (Web Worker pool, 3 workers) for synthesis + OfflineAudioContext reverb + JS mastering; BS.1770 loudness, 4× true peak, loop seam statistic; 16-bit TPDF WAV export. The chain, escalation and runtime stress run through the real bus graph (buildBusGraph) at the default mix, scheduled by the production functions (scheduleRingRotate, scheduleSpokeBeam, startTensionBed/setTension, planTierUp).
commands: bash scripts/use-node.sh node <scratchpad>/audio/harness/cezeri-measure.mjs music|sfx|chain|runtime|escalation|load|trace (harness and entry in the scratchpad, never in the repo)

signatureChain.note: Base spin + Dişli Kilidi chain: rings 0–3 rotate (30–57 slices, 1.3 s / 1.05 s outCubic, staggered), a spoke beam per respin, lock + pins, hub tick k, respin rush, tension bed opening per respin, the class callout when the hub reaches ×10, then the chain cadence. 10-respin case over the base theme is the viral moment (cezeri-chain-10-over-base.wav).

music.about: C Nikriz (C D Eb F# G A Bb), 100 BPM, 20-bar seamless loop (48 s). A: the 4-bar "escapement turn" hook (C · G · F# G F# · Eb D C) on an automaton flute over a 16th santur gear train, its answer on the santur, naqqara in an automaton-drummer figure, the escapement tick-tock on the eighths and a gear clank as the mechanism engages · B: Eb Çargah — the elephant walks — ney over a water organ, santur tremolo, kös and hand cymbals · C: the water-clock breakdown — drips on tuned bowls (C6/G5), the flute alone over F#dim7 and D7, then the gear train winds up (ratchet roll, whirr, naqqara roll) and a santur run over G7 back into the hook.

C Nikriz, 100 BPM, 8-bar loop (19.2 s): the hook on the water organ, its answer on a soft santur, the escapement ticking quietly, water-clock drips on C6/G5, a C–G drone and one chime-rod strike per phrase; no drums.

C Çargah (C major, the Nikriz F# kept as the chromatic neighbour of G), 112 BPM, 16-bar loop (34.3 s). A: the escapement turn in major on a zurna-like reed over a fast 16th santur gear train, naqqara driving, water-organ chords, the clock ticking on the eighths · B: the automaton procession — the flute sings the answer up to G6 with a horn below, wordless male choir, santur tremolo, kös on every downbeat, hand cymbals, an Ab – Bb lift and the gear train winding into the turnaround.

Ambience, 24 s seamless loop: the palace courtyard — the fountain (falling water, splash and fine bubbles), the water clock dripping into two tuned bowls every 2.4 s, the far-off tick-tock of the great clock once a second and a few distant water-whistle birds, over a quiet room tone; no tempo-bound material.

Free-spins intro ("the elephant clock strikes"), C Çargah, 112 BPM: a kös boom and chime rods striking C7–G6–E6–C6 like the clock's hour, a 32nd-note santur glissando up the C pentatonic to A6, a naqqara roll and a rising gear whirr, then a C major roll on the santur with the water organ, male choir, hand cymbals and the kös on beat 4; the feature theme enters at beat 6 (3.21 s).

Retrigger (+4), C Çargah, 112 BPM, 1 bar: a 32nd-note santur flourish G–A–C–D–E–G up to a held C6 with its tremolo, chime rods C6/G6, a kös hit, a hand cymbal and a ratchet burst; ends at beat 3 (1.61 s) and rings over the feature theme.

Feature outro ("the clock winds down"), C Nikriz, 100 BPM: Eb – D7 | Cm with the escapement turn on the automaton flute falling to C, santur rolls, water organ, the last ticks of the escapement slowing, a final drip and a soft kös; the base theme may return at beat 6 (3.6 s).

Total-win fanfare, C Çargah-major, 120 BPM, 4 s: C – Am – F | G – C. A festive santur flourish doubled by the zurna-like reed and the automaton flute, santur rolls, water organ, male choir on the final C with chime rods, naqqara, kös and a cymbal clash.

Big win tier 1 (Büyük), C Çargah-major, 120 BPM, 2 bars (4 s): the escapement turn in major over a 16th santur gear train, water-organ chords, automaton flute on the long notes, naqqara; it lands on a held tonic with a kös, a hand cymbal, a santur roll and chime rods.

Big win tier 2 (Mega), D Çargah-major, 120 BPM, 2 bars (4 s): a santur climb over a 16th santur gear train, water-organ chords, zurna-like reed on the long notes, wordless male choir, the escapement ticking, naqqara; it lands on a held tonic with a kös, a hand cymbal, a santur roll and chime rods.

Big win tier 3 (Süper), E Çargah-major, 120 BPM, 3 bars (6 s): a santur climb over a 16th santur gear train, water-organ chords, zurna-like reed on the long notes, wordless male choir, the escapement ticking, naqqara in double time with a gear-train wind-up; it lands on a held tonic with a kös, a hand cymbal, a santur roll and chime rods.

Big win tier 4 (Efsane), G Çargah-major, 120 BPM, 3 bars (6 s): I – IV | ii – V | I. Santur lead with the zurna-like reed doubling and santur tremolo an octave below, full male choir, water organ, chime rods on every downbeat, the escapement in double time, a naqqara roll into the last bar, kös and hand cymbals.

Max win, A (top of the key ladder), 120 BPM, 3 bars (6 s): IV – V – bVII – I (D – E – G – A) with santur and the zurna-like reed in octaves, santur tremolo, full male choir, water organ, chime rods climbing, a 16th santur gear train, a santur roll, double-time naqqara with a roll, the escapement racing, the kös and the biggest cymbal clash, the gear train winding up.
Count-up bed tier 1: I – IV – vi – IV/V in C Çargah-major at 120 BPM, 4-bar seamless loop (8 s); santur 16ths, drone, bass, the escapement and naqqara tek.

Count-up bed tier 2: I – IV – vi – IV/V in D Çargah-major at 120 BPM, 4-bar seamless loop (8 s); santur 16ths, drone, bass, the escapement and naqqara tek + naqqara düm groove, water organ, hand cymbal.

Count-up bed tier 3: I – IV – vi – IV/V in E Çargah-major at 120 BPM, 4-bar seamless loop (8 s); santur 16ths, drone, bass, the escapement and naqqara tek + naqqara düm groove, water organ, hand cymbal + santur lead and tek 8ths.

Count-up bed tier 4: I – IV – vi – IV/V in G Çargah-major at 120 BPM, 4-bar seamless loop (8 s); santur 16ths, drone, bass, the escapement and naqqara tek + naqqara düm groove, water organ, hand cymbal + santur lead and tek 8ths + male choir, chime rods, kös.

Count-up bed max win: I – IV – vi – IV/V in A Çargah-major at 120 BPM, 4-bar seamless loop (8 s); santur 16ths, drone, bass, the escapement and naqqara tek + naqqara düm groove, water organ, hand cymbal + santur lead and tek 8ths + male choir, chime rods, kös + zurna-like reed doubling the lead, a ratchet roll and gear whirr.

Dişli Kilidi tension bed, 100 BPM, 2-bar seamless loop (4.8 s): kös heartbeat on C, the escapement in sixteenths, ratchet ghosts, a gear clank on each bar, an open-fifth water-organ drone (C2–G2–C3) and the whirr of the gear train. Pitched only on C and G.

Dişli Kilidi upper layer, 100 BPM, 2-bar loop in lock-step with the tension bed: a santur gear train in sixteenths on C–G–D, naqqara tek sixteenths, accented ratchets, kös eighths and a soft cymbal on the second bar. Pitched only on C, G and D.

escalation.note: Büyük → Mega → Süper → Efsane → max with count-up ticks; tier-up hits on the 120 BPM grid (planTierUp), landing at 22.3 s.

loadTiming.note: Three interleaved pairs (Cezeri, Tarhun, …) in one browser session. Core = base theme + first-spin effects (spin, ratchet, ring-stop, ring-whirr, hub-x1..x3, hub-step-1..2, lock, pin, respin, chain-end, beam-1..3, beam-sweep, coin, click, bet). The tension beds lead the lazy batch (< 1 s after core), then hub-step-3..10, hub-x5/x10 and the feature effects; until an asset lands the event falls back (hub step → nearest lower step bent up, hub reveal → lower class, ding → chain-end, others → live fallback voice). The trace (before the rebalance) showed the first core batch at 2× Tarhun's effects audio and the pipe/organ cost weights too low; both were corrected (render.ts CEZERI_VOICE_COST).

engineContract: packages/protocol/src/cezeri.ts cezeri-gears-1 v2 step contract: hub(round 0) → hubReveal(value); rotate (4 rings, held[], pinned[]) → rotate(4 × {ring, distance, ms, delayMs, ease, held: held.length}); win (startRing) → spokeWin(spoke, length, symbol, {startRing}); lock {round, held, newHeld, respin} → gearLock(newHeld.length, {respin}); hub(round k, reason respin) → hubTick(value, k); rotate(k>0) → respin(k) then rotate(...); end {respins, heldSlices, chainCapped} → chainEnd({respins, capped: chainCapped, heldSlices}); scatter → vesselLand(n)… + featureTrigger()/retrigger(); after each free spin → reservoirFill(level); falcon → falconFlight() then falconDrop(ring, slices.length). CEZERI_MAX_RESPINS = 10 in both.

summary.unitTests: 289/289 pass (apps/web, incl. tests/slot-audio-cezeri.test.ts 11 and tests/slot-audio-cezeri-sound.test.ts 4); web typecheck clean; worker 0c5214d456bd

limitations: Nobody has listened to this set: the author cannot hear. Owner listening acceptance is required (WAV per asset; cezeri-chain-10-over-base.wav is the signature moment, cezeri-escalation-max.wav the full climb, cezeri-base.wav / cezeri-feature.wav the themes).
Instruments are synthesized approximations, not recordings; santur, flute, organ and reed colour may read as "synth" on good speakers. Makam colours are 12-TET approximations (no koma intervals).
Vocal callouts are wordless synthetic placeholders; recorded lines plug into setVoiceBank("/audio/voice/cezeri") (22 lines, Turkish texts in CEZERI_VOICE_TEXT) and were tested with fakes only.

The live master limiter is a DynamicsCompressor, not a true-peak limiter: the stacked-effects stress at unity sliders reaches about −0.95 dBTP (default mix −1.06); every rendered asset and the realistic chain scenario stay below −1 dBTP.
Very short UI effects (click, pin, ratchet) read under their momentary class target because they are shorter than the 400 ms window (same as the other sets).
Load times are from a shared 4 vCPU container under other agents' load; only the same-run Cezeri vs Tarhun comparison is meaningful.

Not verified: GitHub CI, a production (next build / Cloudflare) runtime, the /lab/audio?game=cezeri page in a browser, Safari/Firefox, mobile devices, and the game screen wiring (components/cezeri/** is another agent's).
